attributes.residual: THE GUARD IS COARSE HERE, THE COARSENESS IS SOUND, AND RELAXING IT IS AN INTEGRATOR DECISION -- three separate findings. (1) COARSE: the check is `if ('g', 1) in writes: raise` in check_permutation_dependences, and it fires BEFORE the per-resource def-use analysis in the same function. On this window the finer analysis would accept: `addi r1,r1,64` has reads={('g',1)} writes={('g',1)}, `mtlr r0` has reads={('g',0)} writes={'lr'}, they share no resource, both r1-relative LOADS (`lfd`, `lmw`) sit ABOVE the adjust in BOTH streams so the frame is live when they read it either way, and the `blr` is outside the region. (2) SOUND: the blanket form is deliberate and documented at the test, not an oversight -- tools/gdl/tests/test_webfrank.py carries `# 4. THE STACK POINTER. Reordering a region that redefines r1 moves every r1-relative access in it onto a different frame, so the permutation class refuses the region outright` above `test_a_permutation_region_redefining_r1_is_refused`, and `t8_refusal_coverage.py` classes this refusal as PINNED (it is absent from the 12 UNPINNED BOUNDARY rows). Weakening a test-pinned guard on the frame/ABI surface is exactly what the Mandatory result policy forbids a lane from doing unilaterally, so the refusal was recorded rather than engineered around. (3) THE DEMAND IS NOT ZERO, which is why this is a proposal and not a refuted premise. Census run this run over the whole image (`ws_r1_demand_census.py`, promoted as tools/gdl/composed_census/ws_r1_demand_census.py): 3316 paired equal-size functions, 598 of them differing, and 48 whose residual touches an r1-writing word -- a deliberately generous UPPER bound, since it does not check that a permutation would close them. The rows closest to CritterDamagePlayer's shape are the small ones: game/ps2/fakelib::sDvdReadSync (5 differing words), dolphin/dvd/dvdlow::AlarmForWA (10) and ::AlarmForTimeout (10), game/enemy/critter::CritterDamagePlayer (10), game/ui/btext::FontHeight (10, r1 at 0x4c/0x50 -- adjacent, the same epilogue shape), game/sys/recorder::sReticleDepth (11) and game/boss/boss::HealthMeterStart (12). THE ASK: a refinement that keeps the blanket refusal as the default and admits a region redefining r1 ONLY when no memory access in the region is r1-relative, or when every r1-relative access in it is provably on the same side of the adjust in both orders. That is strictly narrower than the current class and fail-closed in the same direction; it is offered as a record, per the Mandatory result policy's rule that class proposals go to the integrator and are never shipped by a lane.
